for the rest of this week the plan is to move the water heaters and the larger boiler parts. those are heavier and we need two people on every move, so i have asked mark to pull two guys from the afternoon shift on wednesday and thursday. if your team is one of those that gets pulled please dont plan anything big for those afternoons, we will try to give them back by 5 but i cant promise it.

a couple of people asked about the inventory counts. yes we are doing a full count of every bin that moves, before and after, and the numbers go into the shared sheet the same day. so far the counts match except for one bin of 3/4 inch ball valves which was short by twelve. we think they were never there in the first place and the old count was wrong, but if anyone remembers pulling a box of those last week without scanning it please tell me, no judgement i just want the numbers to be right.

on the system side, the bin locations update in the warehouse system overnight. that means for one night the system shows the old location for anything we moved that day, so if a picker cant find something on the evening shift they should check the old aisle first. i know this is annoying, it goes away once the whole move is done and we stop doing it in pieces.

safety stuff, which i have to say every time: hard hats and vests in the moving area, no exceptions, and nobody walks through the taped off section while the forklift is running. we had one close call on monday when someone cut through to get to the break room. nobody was hurt but it was close enough that i dont want to see it again.

customers should not notice any of this. orders are still going out the same day and our fill rate this week is actually slightly better then last week, which i did not expect. if you hear from customer service that something is late or missing because of the move, send it to me directly and i will chase it, dont let it sit in the general queue.

next week we start on the pex and the copper fittings, which is the biggest section by far. i am still working out the order with the night shift lead because we want to do as much as possible when the floor is quiet. i will send the plan by friday, if you have opinions about what should move first now is the time, after friday its locked.

one more thing, the new labels. a few of them are peeling off the lower shelves because the shelves were not cleaned before we stuck them on. if you see one coming off please dont throw it away, put it on top of the bin and tell the shift lead, we have a box of replacements and it takes a minute to fix.

thanks everyone for being patient with this, i know its extra work on top of a busy month and the dock has been a mess. it will be worth it, the new layout should cut down walking time a lot once everything is in place. if you have questions grab me on the floor or message me, i am around all week except thursday morning when i am at the supplier meeting.

also, the pizza on friday is still happening, i didnt forget. let me know by wednesday if you have any allergies or if you want something other then pepperoni and cheese, last time we ran out of the vegetarian ones in about five minutes so i will get more of those this time.

last thing i promise. if anyone wants to help with the planning for the pex section, i could really use one person from each shift who knows those aisles well. its maybe two hours of work spread over next week, mostly walking the aisles with me and telling me what will go wrong. tell your lead if you are interested and i will sort out the cover.

and for the people who asked, no the old racking is not being thrown out, its going to the overflow building so if you want to know where something old went, it probably went there. we will put a map up by the time clock once its all set up over there.

ok that really is it. have a good week and please, please watch the forklift path near dock 3.
